title: From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence
abstract: arXiv:2610.02150v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent external sources to solve sequences of knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing methods improve how source content is accessed and organized, while agent-memory systems preserve reusable knowledge from prior interactions, but repeated use of the same source is still largely treated as repeated access rather than an opportunity to progressively improve understanding of that source. We study source learning: developing reusable source-specific competence over a persistent authoritative source. We represent this competence with a persistent source model that captures reusable understanding of the source, including how its knowledge is structured, interpreted, and applied. To construct and progressively refine such models, we propose SourceLearn, which combines two complementary learning mechanisms. translated_title: 从知识访问到源学习：发展特定信息源能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越依赖持久的外部信息源来解决一系列知识密集型任务。现有方法改进了对源内容的访问和组织方式，智能体记忆系统则保存了以往交互中可复用的知识，但重复使用同一信息源在很大程度上仍被视为重复访问，而非逐步加深对该信息源理解的机会。我们研究源学习：即在持久的权威信息源上发展可复用的源特定能力。我们用持久源模型来表示这种能力，该模型捕捉对信息源的可复用理解，包括其知识如何被结构化、解释和应用。为构建并逐步精炼这样的模型，我们提出了SourceLearn，它结合了两种互补的学习机制。自主源学习识别尚未被完全理解的内容并……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“源学习”新范式及SourceLearn方法，通过持久源模型使LLM智能体在反复使用同一权威信息源时逐步积累可复用的源特定理解能力，而非简单重复访问。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "source learning" as a new paradigm and the SourceLearn method, which builds persistent source models enabling LLM agents to progressively accumulate reusable, source-specific competence from repeated use of the same authoritative source, rather than merely performing repeated access.
